sentences.en: Um, I think, you know, companies benefit from this, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为公司其实从中受益，对吧？

sentences.en: Cause if you are over-functioning and overworking and over-performing, they're benefiting.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你过度工作、过度表现，他们就从中获益了。

sentences.en: They're in essence, sometimes getting two or three people for the price of one.
sentences.zh: 本质上，他们有时是用一个人的工资雇到了两三个人的工作量。

sentences.en: And so I do think it is, there's a lot of inside the system that, that encourages this level of imposter.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为，系统内部有很多因素在鼓励这种程度的冒充者心态。

sentences.en: I actually was doing a training recently and someone was saying, look, I, I, I'm working on trying to have more balance in my life and I want to do an adequate job.
sentences.zh: 我最近在做培训时，有人说，看，我正在努力让生活更平衡，我想做一份合格的工作。

sentences.en: And I asked my manager, can I just do an adequate job and not do exceeds expectations?
sentences.zh: 我问我的经理，我能只做一份合格的工作，而不去追求“超出预期”吗？

sentences.en: But then their comp, their comp was, um, their, their, like there's ties to their comp and their bonus structure that if they don't exceed, they don't get anything.
sentences.zh: 但他们的薪酬与奖金结构挂钩，如果他们不超出预期，就什么也得不到。

sentences.en: So if you just do a good enough job at your job, which we're always telling people who have perfectionism, like it's focused on the good enough.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你只是把工作做得足够好——我们总是告诉有完美主义倾向的人要专注于“足够好”——

sentences.en: Like if you just do good enough, you don't get additional compensation.
sentences.zh: 但如果你只是做得足够好，你就拿不到额外的报酬。

sentences.en: So you have to constantly be exceeding to be able to reach certain comp norMs. I do think there's a lot in our systems that really have to change
sentences.zh: 所以你必须不断超越，才能达到某些薪酬标准。我确实认为我们的系统中有很多东西必须改变，

sentences.en: that we don't reinforce this, don't burn people out and use them for what they have and then discard them.
sentences.zh: 这样我们才不会助长这种风气，不会榨干员工，用完就丢。

sentences.en: We have to be more thoughtful about our, the workers in our system and how we take care of them and how we create longevity for their careers.
sentences.zh: 我们必须更体贴地对待系统中的员工，关注我们如何照顾他们，以及如何延长他们的职业寿命。

sentences.en: And I think there's a lot we can do around management and organizations to change these systems that are reinforcing it, you know, ordinarily.
sentences.zh: 我认为在管理和组织方面，我们可以做很多事情来改变这些通常会强化这种心态的系统。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And the other, the other sort of suggestion that I would make, and this is, this is a more difficult one because it really speaks to, to culture is creating an environment
sentences.zh: 另一个建议，这可能更难，因为它真正关乎文化，那就是创造一个环境，

sentences.en: where it's okay to acknowledge that one has made a mistake, to acknowledge that one is not perfect.
sentences.zh: 让人们可以坦然承认自己犯了错，承认自己并不完美。

sentences.en: And this should come from the leaders, from the people, the managers.
sentences.zh: 这应该来自领导者，来自经理们。

sentences.en: And this is a bit, imagine, imagine what it would be like for an employee to have a manager to sort of say, you know what, I messed up.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，如果员工有一个会说“你知道吗，我搞砸了”的经理，那会是什么样？

sentences.en: I dropped the ball here.
sentences.zh: “我在这件事上失职了。”

sentences.en: I made a mistake.
sentences.zh: “我犯了个错误。”

sentences.en: And you know, it's, it's okay.
sentences.zh: “你知道，没关系的。”

sentences.en: You know, we're human.
sentences.zh: “我们都是人。”

sentences.en: Imagine the impact that that would have on employees when their, their managers acknowledge that sometimes they make mistakes as well.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，当经理承认他们有时也会犯错时，这对员工会有多大的影响。

sentences.en: Now.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'll take it one next one step further, which is like, and then do like a postmortem on the mistake.
sentences.zh: 我会再进一步，那就是对错误进行复盘，

sentences.en: So everyone can learn from it.
sentences.zh: 这样每个人都能从中学习。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You know, and, and have such a, more of a growth mindset perspective, as opposed to a fixed mindset perspective about people's capacities and capabilities.
sentences.zh: 你知道，要有一种成长型思维，而不是对人的能力和潜力持固定思维。

sentences.en: Now that exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是这样。

sentences.en: Now we, we all know that changing culture is easier said than done.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，改变文化说起来容易做起来难。

sentences.en: Culture tends to be among the most difficult things to sort of try to change.
sentences.zh: 文化往往是最难改变的东西之一。

sentences.en: But, but if that could happen, it could go such a long ways.
sentences.zh: 但如果能做到这一点，将会产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: I mean, if, if, if companies are really serious about being responsive to the, the needs of their employees, this is one of the things that they absolutely should do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果公司真的认真对待员工的需求，这绝对是他们应该做的事情之一。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The wellbeing of their employees are a lot of talk about wellbeing and mental health and these, these, there are correlates to imposter syndrome to mental health outcomes,
sentences.zh: 员工的福祉，现在有很多关于福祉和心理健康的讨论，这些与冒充者综合征导致的心理健康结果有关，

sentences.en: burnout, depression, anxiety.
sentences.zh: 比如职业倦怠、抑郁、焦虑。

sentences.en: If you want to reduce that in your staff, reduce some of the ways in which you are organized to encourage them to do this, you know.
sentences.zh: 如果你想减少员工中的这些问题，就减少那些鼓励他们产生这种心态的组织方式。

sentences.en: Well, this has been really interesting.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这次谈话非常有趣。

sentences.en: I think you've offered some good advice to people who may be experiencing the phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 我认为你为那些可能正在经历这种现象的人提供了一些很好的建议。

sentences.en: And certainly it doesn't appear that it has held you two back in, in any way in life.
sentences.zh: 当然，这看起来并没有在任何方面阻碍你们两位的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I think you've been quite successful and I've enjoyed spending some time with you.
sentences.zh: 我认为你们都非常成功，我很享受与你们共度的时光。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Likewise.
sentences.zh: 同样。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed it too.
sentences.zh: 我也很享受。

sentences.en: It's been lovely.
sentences.zh: 非常愉快。
